title: Quantifying multilabeled brain cells in the whole prefrontal cortex reveals reduced inhibitory and a subtype of excitatory neuronal marker expression in serotonin transporter knockout rats.
authors: Guo, Chao Ciu-Gwok; Xu, Yifan; Shan, Ling; Foka, Kyriaki; Memoli, Simone; Mulveen, Calum; Gijsbrechts, Barend; Verheij, Michel M; Homberg, Judith R
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习StarDist量化前额叶皮层多标记细胞，研究血清素转运体敲除大鼠的神经元标志物表达，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合建模完全无关。
abstract: The prefrontal cortex regulates emotions and is influenced by serotonin. Rodents lacking the serotonin transporter (5-HTT) show increased anxiety and changes in excitatory and inhibitory cell markers in the prefrontal cortex. However, these observations are constrained by limitations in brain representation and cell segmentation, as standard immunohistochemistry is inadequate to consider volume variations in regions of interest. We utilized the deep learning network of the StarDist method in combination with novel open-source methods for automated cell counts in a wide range of prefrontal cortex subregions. We found that 5-HTT knockout rats displayed increased anxiety and diminished relative numbers of subclass excitatory VGluT2+ and activated DeltaFosB+ cells in the infralimbic and prelimbic cortices and of inhibitory GAD67+ cells in the prelimbic cortex. Anxiety levels and DeltaFosB cell counts were positively correlated in wild-type, but not in knockout, rats. In conclusion, we present a novel method to quantify whole brain subregions of multilabeled cells in animal models and demonstrate reduced excitatory and inhibitory neuronal marker expression in prefrontal cortex subregions of 5-HTT knockout rats.
abstract_zh: 前额叶皮层调节情绪，并受血清素影响。缺乏血清素转运体（5-HTT）的啮齿动物表现出焦虑增加，以及前额叶皮层中兴奋性和抑制性细胞标志物的变化。然而，这些观察受到脑区代表性和细胞分割限制的约束，因为标准免疫组织化学不足以考虑感兴趣区域的体积变化。我们利用StarDist方法的深度学习网络，结合新型开源方法，对广泛的前额叶皮层亚区进行自动化细胞计数。我们发现，5-HTT基因敲除大鼠表现出焦虑增加，并且在边缘下皮层和前边缘皮层中，亚类兴奋性VGluT2+细胞和激活的DeltaFosB+细胞的相对数量减少，在前边缘皮层中抑制性GAD67+细胞的数量也减少。在野生型大鼠中，焦虑水平与DeltaFosB细胞计数呈正相关，但在基因敲除大鼠中则无此相关性。总之，我们提出了一种新方法，用于量化动物模型中多标记细胞的整个脑亚区，并证明5-HTT基因敲除大鼠前额叶皮层亚区中兴奋性和抑制性神经元标志物表达减少。
